journeys.name: Stores and recipe: the three linen stores and what a finished item is made of
journeys.objective: The branch names its linen store, its laundry and its ward store, and each finished linen item has its recipe.
journeys.userRole: Linen supervisor, Inventory administrator (test persona; only admin was available)
journeys.preconditions: User holds the linen right. One branch is chosen in the header. Three stores and the items exist in Inventory (07-inventory.xlsx).
journeys.steps:
1. Opens Linen and clicks Stores and recipe in the menu
2. Clicks "Save stores"
3. Types the three stores into the first three inputs and clicks "Save"
4. Opens the dialog, types the finished item, the component in "Component / linen store" and the quantity, chooses "Save recipe" and clicks "Save"
5. Saves a second component for the same finished item
journeys.expectedOutcome: One set of stores per branch; a recipe lists the components of one finished item.
journeys.observedOutcome: 2026-10-13: /id/linen/stores opened (HTTP 200, title "Stores and recipe"). The steps were not executed: they change data. 2026-10-13: "Save stores" on /linen/stores opened the dialog "Stores and recipe"; fields: "Component / linen store", "Contractor / laundry", "Sterile / ward store", "Finished item", "Quantity", "Action"; buttons: Close, Save. Nothing was saved.
journeys.failureScenarios: A store or an item that Inventory does not have; a quantity of 0 (test case below).
journeys.validationNotes: Written in the application pass of 2026-10-13 from the screen code and the English message texts, because no earlier journey mentions this action. Not executed; texts are the English ones, the session of the pass was English. In the pass of 2026-10-13 2 of 5 steps were confirmed read-only against the live screen or dialog.

journeys.name: Work order: having finished linen made, receiving it and charging the contractor's bill
journeys.objective: Linen is sewn by a contractor from the hospital's cloth: the cloth leaves the linen store, the finished items come in with batch and expiry, and the contractor's charge reaches Finance.
journeys.userRole: Linen supervisor, Accountant (test persona; only admin was available)
journeys.preconditions: User holds the linen right. One branch is chosen in the header. The stores are named and the finished item has a recipe (journey above). The components are in stock in the linen store. A go-ahead to create a Finance voucher on the test site.
journeys.steps:
1. Opens Linen and clicks Work orders in the menu
2. Clicks "Save order"
3. Types the number, the contractor and the finished item, clicks "Next", types 10 in "Quantity" and clicks "Save"
4. Pastes the id of the order into "Document" and saves "Send order"
5. Types the batch of the component in "Batch", pastes the order id and saves "Approve order"
6. Types the finished batch, the expiry and 10, pastes the order id and saves "Receive finished"
7. Pastes the id of the receipt into "Document", types the charge in "Amount" and saves "Charge"
journeys.expectedOutcome: States of an order: draft, sent, approved. Approval takes the components; the receipt adds the finished items.
journeys.observedOutcome: 2026-10-13: /id/linen/orders opened (HTTP 200, title "Work orders"). The steps were not executed: they change data. 2026-10-13: "Save order" on /linen/orders opened the dialog "Work orders"; fields: "Number", "Contractor / laundry", "Finished item", "Document"; buttons: Close, Back, Next. Nothing was saved.
journeys.failureScenarios: No recipe; not enough cloth; receiving before approval (test case below).
journeys.validationNotes: Written in the application pass of 2026-10-13 from the screen code and the English message texts, because no earlier journey mentions this action. Not executed; texts are the English ones, the session of the pass was English. In the pass of 2026-10-13 2 of 7 steps were confirmed read-only against the live screen or dialog.

journeys.name: Circulation: clean linen to the ward, soiled linen to the laundry and back
journeys.objective: Every batch of linen can be followed from the linen store to the ward, to the laundry and back, with the stock of each store right at every step.
journeys.userRole: Linen supervisor, Ward nurse, Laundry staff (test persona; only admin was available)
journeys.preconditions: User holds the linen right. One branch is chosen in the header. The stores are named. A batch of a finished item in the linen store.
journeys.steps:
1. Opens Linen and clicks Circulation in the menu
2. Clicks "Clean issue"
3. Types the item, the batch and 4 and clicks "Save"
4. Pastes the id of the issue into "Document", types the ward store in "Sterile / ward store", chooses "Ward receipt" and clicks "Save"
5. Types the item, the batch, the ward store and 4, chooses "Soiled issue" and clicks "Save"
6. Pastes its id, chooses "Laundry receipt" and clicks "Save"
7. Types the item, the batch and 4, chooses "Washed issue" and clicks "Save"; then pastes its id and saves "Linen receipt"
journeys.expectedOutcome: Each issue takes stock from one store; the matching receipt adds it to the next. An issue is received once.
journeys.observedOutcome: 2026-10-13: /id/linen/moves opened (HTTP 200, title "Circulation"). The steps were not executed: they change data. 2026-10-13: "Clean issue" on /linen/moves opened the dialog "Circulation"; fields: "Finished item", "Batch", "Sterile / ward store", "Document", "Quantity", "Action"; buttons: Close, Save. Nothing was saved.

journeys.name: Linen stock in Inventory after a full round
journeys.objective: After a batch went once round, Inventory shows the same total as before and one movement per step.
journeys.userRole: Linen supervisor, Inventory administrator (test persona; only admin was available)
journeys.preconditions: The journeys "Work order" and "Circulation" were run with a known batch.
journeys.steps:
1. Before the round, reads the stock of the batch in the three stores in Inventory
2. Runs clean issue, ward receipt, soiled issue, laundry receipt, washed issue and linen receipt for 4 pieces
3. After each step, reads the stock of the batch in the three stores
4. Opens the stock ledger of Inventory for the item
5. Reads the total over the three stores at the end
journeys.expectedOutcome: The total is unchanged; linen on its way is not counted in any store.
journeys.observedOutcome: 2026-10-13: /id/linen/moves opened (HTTP 200, title "Circulation"). The steps were not executed: they change data.
journeys.failureScenarios: Linen lost between an issue and its receipt with nothing that shows it is on its way.
journeys.validationNotes: Written in the application pass of 2026-10-13 from the screen code and the English message texts, because no earlier journey mentions this action. Not executed; texts are the English ones, the session of the pass was English.
journeys.requiredTestData: The batch and the three stores

journeys.name: Access to Linen: session, licence and write privilege
journeys.objective: The application is reachable only with a session, only on a tenant that holds its licence, and writes need the write privilege.
journeys.userRole: Not signed in; admin of a tenant without the licence; a role without the write privilege
journeys.preconditions: A browser without a session; for the licence and privilege cases, accounts that are not available yet.
journeys.steps:
1. Without a session, opens /id/linen
2. On a tenant without the licence, opens /id/linen
3. With a role without the write privilege, tries to save on a screen of the application
journeys.expectedOutcome: 1. Redirect to /id/login?next=/linen. 2. Redirect to /id/apps (frontend/src/proxy.ts, features/licensing/assert-entitled.ts; licence KLIKMED-IP); the API answers 403 "not entitled for this module". 3. The API answers 403 "missing required privilege".
journeys.observedOutcome: 2026-10-12: without a session /id/linen ended at /id/login?next=%2Flinen (HTTP 200). Steps 2 and 3 not executed: no second tenant and no restricted account were authorised.
journeys.alternativePaths: Deep link to a sub-screen instead of the landing screen.
journeys.failureScenarios: Session expired while a form is open (TBD: behaviour not confirmed).
journeys.dependencies: Accounts per role; a tenant without the licence (README lists the other showcase hosts)
journeys.validationNotes: Generated in this run. Read routes of the application are guarded by the licence only, not by a role (see RISK-01 in qa/open-questions.md).
